_README: Template for mcp_servers.json. On a new machine, copy this file to mcp_servers.json (which is gitignored) and edit the values for your environment. ${NAME} placeholders inside any env value resolve at startup: ${RANDOM_PORT} is reserved for an OS-assigned free TCP port (use it when a server binds a fixed port and you may run multiple MyAgent instances); any other ${SOMETHING} is looked up in your shell environment via os.environ. This lets you keep tokens/secrets in your shell (~/.zshrc, Windows env vars, etc.) instead of committing them to this file. An unset var substitutes to empty string and emits a one-shot warning in the activity output. Substitution applies ONLY to keys inside the env block — args and command stay literal.

_example_with_secret_from_shell_env._comment: Delete the leading underscore on the key name to activate. Set GITHUB_TOKEN in your shell (export GITHUB_TOKEN=ghp_... in ~/.zshrc or .env) before launching MyAgent — the placeholder is resolved at server-spawn time.
